claims.quote: Native to the peat swamps and blackwater streams of Malaysia, Sumatra, and Borneo.
The chocolate gourami, Sphaerichthys osphromenoides, is a small gourami from Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo.
In the latter, records exist from throughout the Malaysian state of Sarawak and Indonesian province of West Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat).
